text:
The first three months of the year are January, February, and March.

Factual data regarding blue whales from the text:
- The adult blue whale is the largest animal on earth.
- The heart of an adult blue whale can weigh almost 1,500 pounds.
- The heart of an adult blue whale is roughly the size of a small car.
- Blue whales can consume up to 4 tons of krill per day during feeding seasons.
- Blue whales use their massive tongue to consume krill.
- The tongue of a blue whale weighs as much as an elephant.
